notes: Select substantive body evidence over navigation when both are present. Main taxonomy is explicitly covered in full, including the previously missed correlation section.
The PCAP article's caption is a specific evidence description, not a stock decorative image; this supports a navigation tag, not independent packet reanalysis.
Temporal tags on Desert Hydra reflect its actual analytic topic. They do not verify its historical claim about a 43-minute BugSleep interval.
Rejected candidates can be reconsidered with better body evidence. No tag is safer than a speculative tag.
